correctness.rationale: The radial moment measure concentrates in annuli centered at its Laplace peak. With annular value c_m, the eigenvalue error is bounded by twice ||c||_infinity times the normalized two-tail mass, which tends to zero. Finite-dimensional homogeneous blocks then make the difference from the arbitrary block-diagonal operator compact, yielding the full l-infinity/c0 Calkin image.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 2026 source constructs only the alternating sequence in one dimension and concludes failure of the square-root-metric description. No inspected source states arbitrary bounded-sequence interpolation modulo compacts, the full l-infinity/c0 radial Calkin image, or the all-dimensional extension. Older radial Toeplitz and small-Fock literature remains a residual coverage risk.

value.rationale: The theorem upgrades a single counterexample into a complete quotient-algebra identification: the logarithmic radial Toeplitz algebra is maximal modulo compacts among U(n)-intertwiners. It yields all diagonal Calkin projections and arbitrary compact essential spectra, sharply contrasting with the classical Gaussian radial corona.
